rules_text.raw: If you’ve been to the destination plane and are familiar with a location there, you may choose that location and arrive on target at that location with anyone else you transport with the spell. Augmented : If you expend two uses of mythic power, you grant transported creatures the effects of a planar adaptation spell ( Advanced Player’s Guide 236) upon arrival, lasting for 1 hour.
